# vercel open

Opens the current project in the Vercel Dashboard.

```
vercel open [options]
```

## Options

- `-y, --yes` — Skip confirmation when linking is required (e.g. in non-interactive mode)

## Examples

Open the current project in the Vercel Dashboard

```
$ vercel open
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
